reviewer: Independent Codex researcher/validator; BigInt oracle separate from production implementation

curriculum.standardText: 비례배분을 알고, 주어진 양을 비례배분 할 수 있다.

methods: Independent BigInt N*a/(a+b), N-left and left*b==right*a
All 596 public pool rows + fixed tutorial; exhaustive integer allocations and invalid inputs
5,000 actual campaign() calls; 40,000 ordinary questions; tutorial excluded from first-attempt baselines
sampleProblems(40/17/63) source pool membership and visible prompt parsing
Final QA combined 112 samples re-parsed from Korean prompts and independently recalculated
Production game imports same campaign/isCorrect/sampleProblems/POOL from math.mjs; math source hash unchanged

always-half-floor.basis: Exact solution frequency at this policy allocation in ordinary campaign distribution

always-left-end.basis: Exact solution frequency at this policy allocation in ordinary campaign distribution

always-right-end.basis: Exact solution frequency at this policy allocation in ordinary campaign distribution

repeat-sweep-end-left.basis: Exact solution frequency at this policy allocation in ordinary campaign distribution

repeat-sweep-end-right.basis: Exact solution frequency at this policy allocation in ordinary campaign distribution

uniform-divider-integer-0-N.basis: Exactly one integer solution among N+1 permitted allocations for each problem

no-input.basis: No submitted first attempt; accuracy undefined

arithmeticBounds: N<=90 and a,b<=9; production integer cross-products are <=810, exactly representable as JavaScript integers.
edgeCases: Valid unreduced ratios whose sum does not divide total: 15 at 2:4 -> 5 and 10
